summary: Casa Loma is a Gothic Revival mansion and garden in midtown Toronto, Ontario, Canada, now a historic house museum and landmark. It was built from 1911 to 1914 as a residence for financier Sir Henry Pellatt and designed by architect E. J. Lennox, who also designed several other city landmarks. The note also gives the site's elevation of 140 metres (460 ft) above sea level.

key_facts: Casa Loma is a Gothic Revival style mansion and garden in midtown Toronto, Ontario, Canada.
The name Casa Loma is Spanish for "Hill House".
Casa Loma is now a historic house museum and landmark.
Casa Loma was constructed from 1911 to 1914.
Casa Loma was built as a residence for financier Sir Henry Pellatt.
The architect of Casa Loma was E. J. Lennox.
E. J. Lennox also designed several other city landmarks in Toronto.
Casa Loma sits at an elevation of 140 metres (460 ft) above sea level.
